docs.text: Watching the breakup of Lake Huron ice floating rapidly downstream via the St. Clair River to Lake St. Clair. Folks park their cars and watch, hoping to see an unfortunate ice fishing shanty among the large chunks of ice.
Most of the ice has melted on the St Clair River. The water in Lake Huron and the river is so blue right now. Amazing. Live Stream: #GreatLakes

A lot of ice in the St Clair River now. Especially at Algonac as it accumulates after flowing down from Lake Huron. I read a lot about ice issues on the Great Lakes a few years ago after the YouTube algorithm fed me the live camera feeds. The ice can cause local flooding if it builds up into […]
Lake St Clair is where ICE crosses into Canadian waters to arrest fishermen. But they're every where in the Great Lakes.

The surface ice has backed up past Marine City on the St Clair River. It’ll be icebreaker watching season soon. They’re all doing that at other locations on the Great Lakes at present. According to the Marine Traffic website. Which is equivalent to Flight Radar, but for ships. Marine City live […]

The ice field on the St. Clair River at Marine City is pretty impressive today. Flowing down from Lake Huron and backing up from Algonac and further downstream. Live cam: www.youtube.com/live/bmJhzex... #GreatLakes
The amount of jagged ice in the St Clair River at Algonac is pretty wild. It's flowing down from Lake Huron upstream. Live cam at #GreatLakes
The ice breakers are out on the St Clair River at Algonac. Two working to clear a path for a petrochemical tanker that's coming down river from Sarnia. Live cam: #GreatLakes
